headline: Executive order signed in April 2025 aims to reduce federal regulations seen as limiting business competition.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order targets federal rules that may make it harder for businesses to compete. It likely directs federal agencies to look for and reduce regulations that create barriers to competition. No summary was provided, so the specific steps, agencies, and deadlines are not confirmed here.

who_it_affects.how: They may be asked to review their rules for effects on competition.

who_it_affects.group: Businesses, including companies trying to enter new markets
who_it_affects.how: They could face fewer or changed regulations if agencies revise rules.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed April 9, 2025; specific effective dates and deadlines are not stated in the provided material.
